vehicle_response.baseline: median speed over the first 20 saved frames before left entry
vehicle_response.phase: inclusive first left-of-center frame through first return-after-pass frame
vehicle_response.speed_drop: nonnegative baseline median minus minimum left-phase speed, separately for each actor
vehicle_response.acceleration: saved speed difference over five frames (0.25 s), evaluated at each left-phase frame
vehicle_response.interpretation: observed kinematics only; no causal attribution, interference or legal safe-distance conclusion

controlled_response_comparison.design: synthetic 2x2 factorial: no slowdown, oncoming only, overtaken only, both
controlled_response_comparison.fixed: same 170 m road readback, 480 frame/time identities, ego path and speed, driver-eye sightline, actor identities and lateral placement
controlled_response_comparison.varied: oncoming and overtaken speed and longitudinal position pairs only; changed positions follow changed speeds
controlled_response_comparison.outcome: separate measured left-phase speed drops and five-frame acceleration diagnostics
controlled_response_comparison.limit: synthetic intervention contrast only; no original Native actor reaction, causal inference, interference judgment or legal acceptance

source_binding: SHA-256 of exact saved Native actor rows and two-lane, two-direction road readback

events.left_of_center_entry: first frame with any ego body width extending above Native centerline y=0
events.full_left: first frame with entire ego body width above centerline
events.abreast: first overlapping longitudinal body extents of ego and same-direction overtaken actor
events.pass_return: first frame after full longitudinal overtake with ego body wholly right of centerline
events.oncoming_gap: opposing actor body rear minus ego body front in the saved longitudinal frame
events.clear_sight: saved driver-eye visible flag and measured clear distance throughout left phase

time_uncertainty: one 50 ms frame bracket; no subframe event or physical sightline claim
spatial_uncertainty: synthetic longitudinal body gap uses 2.2 m half-length per actor; original Native rows require each actor's observed body vertices and map readback
original_source_join: prepare_pass.py binds raw Native actor rows, map readback, synchronized video-frame map, 480-frame FFV1 forward video, sightline review packet and exact candidate config by SHA-256; output preserves source hashes and does not assert highway or legal review
sightline_review: original mode requires a human_frame_review packet with a per-frame visible flag and clear distance linked to the exact Native and video frames; pixel-truth and legal acceptance remain independent review tasks

fallback_routing.fallback1: measured entry oncoming body gap < 100 m routes to delayed left entry
fallback_routing.fallback2: measured minimum pre-return oncoming body gap < 20 m routes to shorter exposure request
fallback_routing.fallback3: any saved driver-eye sightline flag false during left-of-center phase routes to abort and rejoin request
fallback_routing.interpretation: engineering routing triggers on source-bound saved observations; thresholds do not establish statutory sufficient distance or safety

statutory_limit: No numeric sufficient-distance threshold is stated in the frozen text; safe operation, actual interference, highway status, hill-crest sightline and legal verdict remain pending original evidence and review
